title: MRI radiomics differentiated gliosarcoma from glioblastoma
summary: In a retrospective MRI cohort of 83 pathology-confirmed gliosarcomas and 100 glioblastomas, the best tumor-mass radiomics model (LASSO plus SVM) achieved AUC 0.85 and accuracy 0.77 on held-out patients and outperformed the tested neuroradiologist readings. This single-center diagnostic comparison does not establish prospective clinical utility.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection and support-vector machine radiomics classifier
organization: Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University; Nankai University

evidence.tested: Patient-level training and held-out evaluation in a single-center retrospective cohort with pathology labels; no external validation is reported.
evidence.unknown: No independent, prospective or clinical-impact evaluation is reported unless specified in the tested field.
evidence.ai_role: Radiomics feature selection and supervised classification distinguished gliosarcoma from glioblastoma using MRI tumor-mass and edema features.
